policy: Keep all originally answered final stages and their upstream chains. Recovered upstream requests are supplemental where a final prompt already existed. Replace original missing finals with their first returned answers. Where no final prompt existed, use recovered upstream answers before the first final. Item-aware cached lookup rejects a changed prompt for any previously asked stage. Both contestants follow the same rule.

watcher.target: Sonnet quota recovery, noise completion and first sealed TEST
watcher.stop: native quota probe no-answer, continuation failure, completed TEST or 12-hour bound

dependencyGuardCorrection.cause: A recovered extraction changes the input of an already asked final-step request.
dependencyGuardCorrection.resolution: Keep original extraction failure supplemental whenever any downstream stage already exists. Restore independent missing references for the first final prompt only when no final prompt existed.
